items.title: Awesome Claude Code
items.content_text: ### Status Lines / Obsidian * [TermaGITchi (⭐12)](https://github.com/TevvvB/termagitchi) by [TevvvB](https://github.com/TevvvB) - A Go CLI that gives each Claude Code session its own creature in the status line, derived by hashing the session id, with one den per git worktree. Where other status-line faces react to what the agent is doing, this one is a stable identity for telling parallel sessions apart, and its expression tracks repository hygiene: uncommitted files, unpushed commits, distance behind trunk and the last test result.\        * [tmux-claude-status-tabs (⭐2)](https://github.com/LiveNL/tmux-claude-status-tabs) by [LiveNL](https://github.com/LiveNL) - Shows each Claude Code session's state in the tmux tab bar, per window: an animated spinner while it works, amber when it waits on input, red on a permission request, green when done. Event-driven via hooks with no polling; catches unreported transitions (Esc, permission grants, stop-hook continuations) with transcript watchers. 260+ test assertions run in CI.\        ### Agent Orchestration / Dynamic Workflows * [Dynamic Workflow Design Patterns (⭐0)](https://github.com/zircote/workflows-plugin) by [Robert Allen](https://github.com/zircote) - A Skill based on [this](https://zircote.com/field-notes/dynamic-workflow-patterns/) extremely well authored article about dynamic workflows. Detailed explanations regarding the Workflow tool and sensible advice covering a range of patterns and anti-patterns.\        ### Memory & Context Persistence / Dynamic Workflows * [faf-cli (⭐35)](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam/faf-cli) by [Wolfe-Jam](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam) - Authors and versions CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md from a repository's actual detected stack, so Claude Code's project context stays in sync with the code instead of drifting. One typed source file (project.faf, an IANA-registered media type) is the single origin for every assistant's context file; a deterministic score reports how complete that context is. The file lives in the repo and carries no telemetry.\
items.content_html:

Where other status-line faces react to what the agent is doing, this one is a stable identity for telling parallel sessions apart, and its expression tracks repository hygiene: uncommitted files, unpushed commits, distance behind trunk and the last test result.\       
  • tmux-claude-status-tabs (⭐2) by LiveNL - Shows each Claude Code session's state in the tmux tab bar, per window: an animated spinner while it works, amber when it waits on input, red on a permission request, green when done. Event-driven via hooks with no polling; catches unreported transitions (Esc, permission grants, stop-hook continuations) with transcript watchers. 260+ test assertions run in CI.\

  • Dynamic Workflow Design Patterns (⭐0) by Robert Allen - A Skill based on this extremely well authored article about dynamic workflows. Detailed explanations regarding the Workflow tool and sensible advice covering a range of patterns and anti-patterns.\

The file lives in the repo and carries no telemetry.\

items.content_text:
### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [qmax-mcp (⭐2)](https://github.com/Quality-Max/qmax-mcp) - MCP server and CLI that gives coding agents independent QA evidence before they declare a web change done: scans a URL for console errors, broken links, accessibility issues, Core Web Vitals, SEO, security headers, and cookies/trackers, then generates and runs a deterministic Playwright repro behind a human-approval gate.

### Software / Test Data Management

*   [TempMailGrab](https://tempmailgrab.com/api-docs) - Disposable email API for temporary inboxes, OTP extraction, verification links, and webhooks in Playwright, Cypress, and CI tests.

### Software and Tools

*   [Pangolinfo](https://www.pangolinfo.com/amazon-data-mcp/) - MCP server and REST API exposing 19 read-only Amazon data tools: product details, reviews, keyword search, category and niche analysis, Best Sellers, New Releases, and seller storefronts, plus WIPO trademark and US PACER patent litigation lookups. Connects over Streamable HTTP; Python client available via `pip install pangolinfo-mcp`.
